caption: The drawing depicts a single bonnet, rendered predominantly in shades of brown and sepia. The bonnet has a wide, curved brim that extends outward and a gathered, ruched crown section. There is a decorative ribbon that encircles the base of the crown, tied in a bow with two long tails hanging down. Attached to the side or back of the bonnet is a braided cord that ends in two tassels, each featuring multiple small, rounded elements. The bonnet appears to be made of a soft, textured fabric with variations in shading that create a sense of depth and folds. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or visual elements, and the artist's name, “NANCY GRIM,” is written in small letters at the bottom right corner.
title: Bonnet
